nodes.label: B1: second tower measurement disagrees (+0.691 vs +0.237 mm)
nodes.norm_label: b1: second tower measurement disagrees (+0.691 vs +0.237 mm)
nodes.rationale: Same two scans, different measurement points; the 0.45 mm spread is as large as the gap between fender braces and strut tower brace, so 'fender braces did the most / 86 percent' is not safe until the owner says which measurement is right.

nodes.label: B2: ranking and mechanism claims the data does not support
nodes.norm_label: b2: ranking and mechanism claims the data does not support
nodes.rationale: The script ranks at the end what it refused to rank earlier; 'diminishing returns' is a mechanism stated as fact while both braces (0.436) is worse than fender-only (0.237); no repeat scan shows the noise floor.

nodes.label: B3: whole-body heat-map claims asserted from maps showing panels and alignment
nodes.norm_label: b3: whole-body heat-map claims asserted from maps showing panels and alignment
nodes.rationale: Maps on a +-15 mm scale cannot see the 1.695 mm tower effect; twist is an interpretation that depends on the unknown alignment method; hinged panels and refitted fenders explain hot spots; colour reads are not values in the files.

nodes.label: B4: wrong burned-in title in the fender-only section (5:09)
nodes.norm_label: b4: wrong burned-in title in the fender-only section (5:09)
nodes.rationale: The fender IRL span ends on the first second of the fender+strut scanning shot, showing 'Scanning Fender Brace + Strut Brace' two sections early; fix by ending the span at rough cut ~321.1.

nodes.label: B5: rough-cut 'How to read the heatmaps' legend card contradicts what follows
nodes.norm_label: b5: rough-cut 'how to read the heatmaps' legend card contradicts what follows
nodes.rationale: Its scale is +-8 mm while the next six heat cards are +-15, its ramp centres green on 0, and its text asserts things the pages do not show; replace with a card built from the real colour bar.

nodes.label: B6: line lengths assume 2.9 words/s, voice clone reads 2.2
nodes.norm_label: b6: line lengths assume 2.9 words/s, voice clone reads 2.2
nodes.rationale: At the clone's pace several IRL shots run out of picture and number lines are undercounted by dur(); time cards from the generated audio, not word count.

nodes.label: Body percentages (58/60/91/74) must be disclosed as our own calculation
nodes.norm_label: body percentages (58/60/91/74) must be disclosed as our own calculation
nodes.rationale: They are computed from the STLs, not values in the xlsx or PDFs, so the script header claiming every number is from the files became false.

nodes.label: House rules to confirm (voice clone consent, imperial units)
nodes.norm_label: house rules to confirm (voice clone consent, imperial units)

nodes.label: v3 problem: strut-top cross-check undercuts unqualified conclusion lines
nodes.norm_label: v3 problem: strut-top cross-check undercuts unqualified conclusion lines
nodes.rationale: By the strut-top measure the fender braces did not reduce the spread and the unbraced spread is ~0.4 mm, so 'every setup cut that spread by more than half' holds only for the xlsx engine-bay width.

nodes.label: Verdict: not ready for voice
nodes.rationale: Tower numbers match the xlsx, but conclusions lean on 0.2-0.5 mm gaps the data cannot rank, and a ninth unused PDF gives a different answer for the fender braces.

nodes.label: Voice analysis vs owner transcript (So/actually/just tics, missing questions)
nodes.norm_label: voice analysis vs owner transcript (so/actually/just tics, missing questions)
nodes.rationale: 13 of 27 lines open with 'So' and the owner's rhetorical questions are missing, so the draft does not sound like the owner.

nodes.label: Music: Epidemic Sound tracks fingerprint-matched per section
nodes.norm_label: music: epidemic sound tracks fingerprint-matched per section
nodes.rationale: The rough cut is not one continuous track after 3:04, so v6's un-ducked bed was a patchwork; v7 lays the real tracks per section at one level.

nodes.label: Shoot order (strut -> both -> fender) vs requested story order (control -> fender -> strut -> both)
nodes.norm_label: shoot order (strut -> both -> fender) vs requested story order (control -> fender -> strut -> both)
nodes.rationale: Audio after 3:04 is clip-native shop sound and silent on cards, so re-ordering does not break music.

nodes.label: Strut-top spread cross-check (local trimmed ICP)
nodes.rationale: At the strut tops fender-only is NOT smaller than unbraced while the xlsx engine-bay width says 1.695 -> 0.237; the two definitions disagree, so the script must not rank the braces or recommend one.
